attack_plan.narrative: Unusual activity has been reported above the Kremlin, with white smoke rising from its roof. This development has sparked speculation among Russian citizens and international observers. A mysterious tweet from an unknown account suggests a 'new Putin' might be in place, though the authenticity of this claim remains unverified. In response, the Kremlin released a photograph of Putin alongside U.S. President Obama, attempting to reassure the public. However, concerns persist regarding the sudden disappearance of Putin, particularly given the recent military parade preparations in Moscow, marking the one-year anniversary of the Crimea occupation. These unexplained events and the absence of Putin have led some analysts to suggest internal power struggles within the Russian government, hinting at a possible 'palace coup.' The true nature of Putin's absence and the identity of the 'new Putin' remain unclear until further evidence emerges.
